مقدمة

This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first
draft initiated by eng. Ekramy Mostafa Mohamad, accepted by technical expert eng Hassan El-Behiry, and approved by eng. فتحي السيد head 
 sector of Kurimat PS.

This document 
 certified by eng. جمال الدين عبد الوهاب UEEPC general director of
 inspection & quality control and MPIS Coordinator
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.

Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل 
 is required.

Wear your 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, 
 safety glass ...etc
Disconnect all power to motor prior to initiating any maintenance or repairs.
Avoid contact with rotating parts.

Act with care in accordance with prescribed procedures, in handling and 
 lifting this equipment.
Be sure shaft key is fully captive before unit is energized.

Always be sure oil lubricated units are filled with correct oil to proper 
 level before operating.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Permanent Checks

The indications given by the temperature measuring devices, and by the other 
 protection devices, must be in accordance with the values given by connection 
 diagram.
Check that there is no abnormal noise or vibration.

Check the condition of the different parts of the machine in case of abnormal 
 operation (for example: heating, abnormal noise, abnormal current ...), to 
 dismantle it partially or completely and to overhaul it.

If the machine is too dirty, it can be cleaned with a cloth impregnated with 
 turpentine.
Check the insulation resistance of the windings after cleaning.

sections.text: Air Filter Cleaning

Unscrew bolts securing the air inlet panels to the ventilation hood and remove 
 the panel including the hood.
Clean the filter with compressed air or with water to remove the dusts.
Use water with addition of sodium carbonate if the filter is too dirty.
لا تستخدم أي منظف آخر.
Dry the filter completely with warm air before machine start-up.

sections.text: Supports for Dismantling

Use two supports when dismantling a bearing, to remove the parts out of the 
 shaft:

A support "A" placed at the end of the shaft, or eventually at the end of the 
 extension shaft.
A support "B" placed as close as possible to the frame.
If there is not enough space for a support, replace it with a sling.
Make sure that the supports do not damage the machined parts of the shaft.

sections.text: Rotor Dismantling

Carry out the preliminary operations before dismantling and dismantle the 
 bearings in order to remove the rotor.
Prepare a steel tube and put it in the shaft to handle the rotor.

Measure the inside diameters of the tube "should be between 3 to 6 mm greater 
 than the shaft diameters".

Put a thin copper sheet (between 0.5 and 1 mm) lining its inside in order to 
 protect the machined parts.
Length of tube fitted to the shaft: about 350 mm.
Tube length about 1500 mm.
Place slings at both ends of rotor + tube and remove the assembly.

Avoid all stator-rotor contact, which could damage the magnetic circuits and 
 the windings.

sections.text: قم بإزالة الدوار
Lay the rotor on a mobile trolley.
Remove the slings.

Take the trolley with the rotor away from the stator and remove the handling 
 tube.

sections.text: إعادة التجميع

Reassemble the various pieces in reverse an order of the steps used for 
 dismantling.

During reassembly take care that insulated parts do not scrape against iron 
 parts and that the rotor does not scrape against the stator.
Check the cleanliness of the various parts.
Put oil on the surfaces in contact with the shaft and on the sleeve.

Carefully clean the machined surfaces covered with sealing paste and put some 
 more paste (Type Hylomar 32M or H for instance) before reassembly.

Make sure to put paste on both sides that have to be jointed, place it evenly 
 in thin coats free of lumps.
Check that all bolts are well tightened and put the bolt stops.

sections.text:
Bearing Lubrication 
 (regard to lubricant 
oil equivalence 
chart at the last page)

تحمل الزيت المشحم ذاتيًا 
مشحم

Each bearing is provided with an oil sight glass with the indication of "mini" 
 and "maxi" oil level.
Check The oil level must be between those two marks, motor in idle condition.

Bearing oil and impurities must be periodically drained before to fill new 
 oil.
For that purpose the bearing is provided with an oil drain plug.

Oil must be filtered, or new oil must be put:
 6 hours, then 150 hours after the first start-up, then the recommended 
 draining interval is : 8000 hours.

Recommended oil quantity according to ISO VG 46 specifications is 13 liters 
 for Driving End bearing and 8 litres for Non-Driving end bearing.
Check periodically the oil quality, specially after the first start-up.
ويجب تغيير الزيت فور تغير لونه أو لزوجته.
